property_summary: For any target address that is a contract which deliberately uses more than 2300 gas in its receive/fallback (so a transfer would fail), the reference C's sendMoney never reverts (it returns/continues because it uses low-level call and checks the boolean), while the mutant using transfer will revert; therefore for all admissible inputs the reference's sendMoney call completes (ok == true) but the mutant can cause it to revert (ok == false) for some fuzzed value of _value and attacker contract address.
change_summary: Change the call to use transfer instead of low-level call, which will revert on failure and forward 2300 gas.
